create_async_dynamicbatch_tokenizer: create an AsyncDynamicbatchTokenizer instance with a tokenizer, max_batch_size, and batch_wait_timeout_s parameters
encode_single_prompt: encode a single string prompt asynchronously using the AsyncDynamicbatchTokenizer.encode method
call_tokenizer_async: call the AsyncDynamicbatchTokenizer as an async callable to encode a single prompt

process_dynamic_batch: process a dynamic batch of encode requests, batching identical kwargs or falling back to individual processing
